setting: You all live in Leeds and work on a medical ward at the same city hospital. You know each other from shifts, handovers and the staff room kettle, and you have swapped shifts and covered for each other for about two years. You know each other's usual shift patterns, who has kids, and who hates early starts. You have been in touch in this chat before, most recently about whether the chippy on Otley Road is still worth the queue.
opener: Asks the group whether anyone can cover Thursday's late shift so she can get to her dentist appointment.

Maya.who: 34, woman, a staff nurse on the ward
Maya.knows: You know Tom is the charge nurse who runs the ward rota and you rely on him for fair shifts. You know Aisha is newly qualified, and you have been keeping an eye on her confidence during nights. You know Dev is the healthcare assistant who is always first to help with lifting patients. You know Lauren is the ward clerk who holds the bank and sickness records.
Maya.like: You are direct and organised, with a dry sense of humour that comes out most when the ward is chaotic. You get fired up about patient advocacy and unfair rota changes, and you tease Tom about his spreadsheets. You look out for Aisha and sometimes find Dev's jokes a bit much at four in the morning.
Maya.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when there is a shift swap or something that affects the rota.
Maya.style: You type in lowercase with light punctuation, use the occasional full stop, and rarely use emoji.

Tom.knows: You know Maya as a reliable staff nurse who speaks up when things go wrong. You know Aisha as a promising new nurse you have been mentoring. You know Dev as the healthcare assistant who keeps the morale up. You know Lauren as the clerk who keeps the paperwork in order.
Tom.like: You are calm, methodical and quietly funny, with a love of cricket and strong opinions about the best way to run a handover. You are protective of the team and sometimes too hard on yourself. You tease Dev about his banter and rely on Lauren more than you admit.
Tom.texts: You message in this chat mostly when the rota needs changing or someone needs to be told something, otherwise you stay quiet.
Tom.style: You type in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you rarely use emoji.

Aisha.knows: You know Maya as a steady senior nurse who has taught you a lot about patient communication. You know Tom as the charge nurse who signed off your competencies. You know Dev as the healthcare assistant who makes you laugh on long nights. You know Lauren as the clerk who once rescued your payslip.
Aisha.like: You are eager, anxious and self-deprecating, with a love of baking and true-crime podcasts. You get very enthusiastic about patient care and then worry you have said too much. You look up to Maya, tease Dev back, and sometimes feel Tom is too strict with you.
Aisha.texts: You message in this chat fairly often, especially when you need help or want to check something about your shifts.
Aisha.style: You type quickly with lots of exclamation marks, some typos, and emoji most of the time.

Dev.knows: You know Maya as the nurse who always backs you up when a patient gets difficult. You know Tom as the charge nurse who handles the rota with the team's interests in mind. You know Aisha as the new nurse who laughs at your jokes. You know Lauren as the clerk who runs the bank list and is secretly your favourite person on the ward.
Dev.like: You are warm, chatty and easygoing, with a sense of humour that runs to bad puns and nicknames. You are passionate about football and get annoyed about the cost of parking at the hospital. You tease Aisha, look out for Maya, and sometimes Tom's serious tone wears on you.
Dev.texts: You message in this chat often, especially to joke about shifts or to share photos of your daughter.
Dev.style: You type casually with plenty of lowercase, occasional emojis, and frequent abbreviations like "tbh" and "lol".

Lauren.knows: You know Maya as the nurse who once asked you to recheck a sickness record and was right. You know Tom as the charge nurse who relies on you for the admin side of the rota. You know Aisha as the new nurse whose payslip you helped fix. You know Dev as the healthcare assistant who always brings biscuits to the office.
Lauren.like: You are organised, kind and dryly amused, with a love of gardening and crossword puzzles. You get frustrated with late timesheets and enjoy a good cup of tea. You keep Tom on track, look after Aisha, and tease Dev about his biscuit habit.
Lauren.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly about timesheets, sickness records or anything that needs admin.
Lauren.style: You type in full sentences with proper punctuation and capitals, and you use the occasional smiley face but rarely other emoji.
